commitReviewed: 7370da6d9 (ks1 fix round; Sukri cards carried by wip sync 49ac6312e). Kemdo cards are unchanged since ks1 (no diff b3df6d3a3..HEAD).
method: Read every shipped splash and portrait (base and both skins) at full size, at 480 px card size and at 128/64 px chip size, plus the icons. Zoomed faces, hands and feet at 2.4-8x and compared each card with its 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_<kind>_3d.png) and with three_sukri_shadeprint. Sampled under-eye luminance, eye saturation, pupil colour and mask colour with PIL. Ran card_qa.py kemdo sukri (12 cards, 0 gate misses) and node tools/gen_store.ts --check. No re-render: read-only verifier.
storeGate: pass: store.json is current (32 offers, 8 shelves; dE gate 32/32 pass)
cardQa: pass: 12 cards, 0 gate misses (speckle, highlights, mad, pupil)
scoreNote: Gauge only, against a recent LoL splash. Kemdo is unchanged: painted, on-model and coherent, but the figure is small in the splash frame and the wrapped face has no focal read at 480 px. Sukri is up from 4.5. The Shadeprint hollow pupils, the ember irises and the scythe crop are fixed, and the base splash is a clean paint with a better lantern fist. Two Stillwater cards and the base portrait still carry drip or streak marks under the eyes, which come from the render's eye-lid geometry and shading, not from the paint. The face wipe did not reach them.
ks1Closed: sukri_shadeprint_splash hollow pupils: pupils now sample dark crimson (43,12,17), luma 19 against iris 111.
sukri_portrait ember irises: the eyes are muted dark brown, the same as the render (gate eye_ds 7.0).
sukri_shadeprint mask colour: splash mask median (184,151,120) and portrait mask (194,159,127) now read as one #B39272 mask.
sukri_shadeprint_portrait scythe read: the victory bust has no staff crook in frame.
sukri_splash jaw crack and forehead grain: gone on the painted v2. The lantern fist is turned and reads as a gloved fist with knuckles, no longer stacked rolls.

Watch: the right boot's toe fades pale into the ground with only a weak contact shadow (x 1200-1240, y 840-870).
A light paint over the render. The eyes are dark with small highlights inside the wrap slit, not glowing. The hood is soft and rounded. The hand on the haft has separate fingers.

On-model with the 3D, with a clear lidded eye. Minor, same as ks1: the raised fist sits beside the staff without gripping it, so the staff stands free (also in the 3D). The cream rim on the boot backs is fainter but still visible at full size.
Lidded eyes with pupils and a rounded hood. It is the one 3D card in Kemdo's line, a mild style break.

On-model with the 3D: the lens is held forward, the staff tip shows above it and the hand is on the hip. The warm grade is kept. The eye is orange-lidded and does not glow (card_qa pupil 61 against iris 112).
On-model, with a clear eye and the lantern grade.

On-model with the re-render: same pose, silhouette and kit. The jaw crack and the forehead grain are gone, and the lantern fist reads as a gloved fist. Eyes are amber almonds with dark pupils and are not saturated. The soft shading under both eyes is about 5 L* darker than in the render (x 1012-1040, y 256-270) and does not read as a streak at card size. Sensitivity WATCH, unchanged at the root: cream cross-bandaged torso and arms with a pale smiling face disc lean toward a mummy or doll read at full size. The GLB carries this (CW6 cream wraps), so it is not a card defect.

Tear-streak class. Below the viewer-right eye, a dark curtain with two drips hangs about 10 px under the lower lid (x 240-296, y 292-304; row 300 reads ~117-120 against a 165-170 cheek, a lighter gap at x 266-272 splits it into two drips). The 3D reference has the same marks, so they come from the render's eye-lid geometry or shadow, and the paint gate's streak 0.0 misses them. A smaller dark tick drops from the viewer-left eye's outer lower lid. A faint jaw line remains below the right mouth corner (x ~290-300, y 362-390). The irises are now muted (fixed). The jaw line is faint, but the drips read at full size and still at card size.

ks1's drip ticks are still there: a small dark tick hangs under each eye from the lower lid at about (1115,325) and (1242,325), luma 83-94 against a 139-165 cheek. They are identical in the 3D reference, so the card face wipe did not remove them. The vertical lines beside the nose from the inner eye corners remain. Heavy half-lidded amber eyes give a sly or glaring read at card size (watch). Grounding is good, with contact shadows under both boots.

Faint vertical streak lines run down both cheeks from below the eyes (crop x 300-340, y 210-240 in the 512 card), and a dark stain hangs under the viewer-right eye: the eye-to-cheek streak class. They are the same in the 3D. The pale grey-green disc with a fixed grin inside the dark hood still leans toward mannequin at card size. It is on-model otherwise, with no invented props.

The hollow pupils are fixed. New eye read: the eye whites are saturated yellow (median (142,102,49), S p95 ~189) around small crimson pupils (43,12,17). On a gold mask against a violet plate this gives yellow eyes with red dots at card and chip size, a glowing or demonic-eye watch that leans fail. The in-game three render shows amber irises with dark pupils, not crimson. ks1's stray dark triangular speck is still left of the mask (about x 1073, y 350). The mouth interior is lighter yellow than the mask. The wraps are now a desaturated lavender (torso median (112,101,136)) and the contact shadow is present (ground under boots ~(122,98,155) against (174,149,201) further off), so those ks1 items are closed. The finish is still a flat 3D still that sits apart from the painted plate.

The victory bust has no crook, so the scythe read is gone. The mask matches the splash. The eyes are dark with pupils (card_qa pupil 9 against iris 62). Watch: a sly side-eye under a violet hood; the fist is four rounded finger rolls; a faint jaw line at the lower right of the disc (about x 297, y 390).

problems.what: Drip ticks, a two-drip shadow curtain and cheek streaks under the eyes, all present in the 3D reference. The card face wipe (card_hands._face_wipe) and the paint gate's streak check (0.0-0.02) both miss them because they are lid geometry or cast shadow, not base colour.
problems.fix: Fix the lower-lid geometry of the eye inlay, or cap the eye-socket shadow, in the Sukri face (units or GLB lane, or the card-only face pass): no dark mark may extend more than 2 px below the lower lid. Add a card_qa check that compares a band 4-16 px under each eye with the cheek (fail at > 25 L darker in any 3-px column run). Re-render and repaint the three cards.

problems.what: Saturated yellow eye whites with crimson pupils read as yellow-and-red eyes at card size. ks1's stray dark speck left of the mask is still there.
problems.fix: Grade the Shadeprint eye inlay to the in-game amber iris with a dark-umber pupil (not crimson) and lower the eye-white saturation to the mask's level. Remove the speck at about (1073,350) in the compositor. Then re-render the splash.

problems.what: Cream cross-bandaged torso and arms with a pale face disc lean toward a mummy or doll read at full size, the ruling 30 sensitivity class. The source is the GLB (CW6 cream wraps).
problems.fix: Raise with the units lane: darker or broader wrap bands (the sheet's #7E766A brown-grey for the thick bands), or fewer crossing strips on the torso.

problems.what: Kemdo's left forearm reads as a stump under the pauldron. On Highrim the staff stands free beside the fist. A faint pale rim remains on the boot backs.
problems.fix: Pose the card's left arm so the hand shows, close the fist round the staff on Highrim, and tighten rim_low on the boots.
